title: vagrant login fails behind a proxy
body:
On windows and mac, if you are behind a proxy and have set the env var `http_proxy` and/or `https_proxy`, then `vagrant login` will fail with 

```
Vagrant-proxyconf plugin found...
Setting 'http_proxy'...
Setting 'https_proxy'...
Setting 'no_proxy'...
DEBUG loader: Loading from: root (evaluating)
DEBUG loader: Configuration loaded successfully, finalizing and returning
DEBUG push: finalizing
 INFO host: Autodetecting host type for [#<Vagrant::Environment: /Users/dhg777/Workspaces/test-iz-headless>]
DEBUG host: Trying: arch
DEBUG host: Trying: darwin
 INFO host: Detected: darwin!
 INFO runner: Preparing hooks for middleware sequence...
 INFO runner: 3 hooks defined.
 INFO runner: Running action: environment_unload #<Vagrant::Action::Builder:0x0000010330ca38>
 INFO warden: Calling IN action: HashiCorp Background Check: End
 INFO logger: Cleaning up background activation thread...
 INFO warden: Calling OUT action: HashiCorp Background Check: End
/opt/vagrant/embedded/lib/ruby/2.0.0/net/http/response.rb:119:in `error!': 407 "Proxy Authentication Required" (Net::HTTPServerException)
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/lib/ruby/2.0.0/net/http/response.rb:128:in `value'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/lib/ruby/2.0.0/net/http.rb:913:in `connect'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/lib/ruby/2.0.0/net/http.rb:862:in `do_start'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/lib/ruby/2.0.0/net/http.rb:851:in `start'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/rest-client-1.6.9/lib/restclient/request.rb:206:in `transmit'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/rest-client-1.6.9/lib/restclient/request.rb:68:in `execute'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/rest-client-1.6.9/lib/restclient/request.rb:35:in `execute'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/rest-client-1.6.9/lib/restclient.rb:74:in `post'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/plugins/commands/login/client.rb:48:in `block in login'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/plugins/commands/login/client.rb:92:in `with_error_handling'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/plugins/commands/login/client.rb:45:in `login'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/plugins/commands/login/command.rb:61:in `execute'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/lib/vagrant/cli.rb:42:in `execute'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/lib/vagrant/environment.rb:301:in `cli'
    from /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/vagrant-1.7.4/bin/vagrant:174:in `<main>'
```

An oddness I see is that in the /opt/vagrant/embedded/gems/gems/ there exist more than one version of rest_client.

on mac I have rest-client-1.6.9 and rest-client-1.8.0

on windows I have rest-client-1.6.9 and rest-client-1.8.0-x86-mingw32

We appear to be using the 1.6.9 version.  That version doesn't work when passing the proxy settings in the RestClient::Request.execute(),  (see https://github.com/rest-client/rest-client/blob/1.6-legacy/README.rdoc)
